column1: 21002§stagnant§ˈstæɡnənt§adj. 停滞的，不发展的§Because of economic crisis, our company's sale has remained stagnant.§由于经济危机，我们公司的销售额停滞不前。
21003§attach§əˈtætʃ§v. 系，贴；认为有重要性（或意义、价值等）；使附属，附加；（使）与…有联系§They attached the coupon to the front of the letter.§他们把优惠券附在信的正面。
21004§flip§flɪp§v. 轻抛；轻弹§A switch was flipped and the machine began to operate.§轻弹开关，机器便开始运作。

21005§comment§ˈkɒment§n. 注释，评论，意见 v. 注释，评论§Customer's comments, both positive and negative, are recorded by staff and are collated regularly to identify opportunities for improvement of products.§员工记录来自顾客的正反两方面意见，（公司）定期整理核查这些意见，以确定是否能根据意见来提高产品的质量。
21006§flame§fleɪm§n. 火焰；强烈的感情 v. 燃烧；（因强烈情绪而）变红§The house was in flames.§房子失火了。
21007§emphasize§ˈemfəsaɪz§vt. 强调，着重§This report emphasizes that cancer is not caused by a single element in cigarette smoke.§这一报告强调，癌症并不是由香烟烟雾中的某单一成分导致的。
21008§foresee§fɔːˈsiː§vt. 预见，预知§What changes do you foresee in the educational field in the next 50 years?§在未来的50年里，你认为教育界会发生什么变化？
21009§historic§hɪˈstɒrɪk§adj. 有历史意义的；历史的，历史性的§There are a number of historic ships docked in the harbour.§这个港湾停泊了很多具有历史意义的船舶。
21010§provision§prəˈvɪʒn§n. 供应，（一批）供应品；准备，预备；条款，规定；给养，口粮§The country has enough provisions of grain for the future several years.§这个国家备有足够的粮食储备以供未来几年使用。
21011§president§ˈprezɪdənt§n. 总统；校长，会长，（大会）主席§A lecture will be given by the president of the Union.§该协会主席将发表演讲。
21012§internist§ɪnˈtɜːnɪst§n. 内科医师§The professor who teaches us is a respected internist.§教我们的那个教授是一位受人尊敬的内科医师。
21013§reception§rɪˈsepʃn§n. 接收，接受；接待；欢迎会，招待会；接收效果§The students' dormitory is to the right of the reception desk.§学生宿舍在接待处的右边。
21014§suspend§səˈspend§vt. 吊，悬挂；推迟；暂停，中止§The party representative suspended the talk with the government.§该党代表暂停了和政府的对话。
21015§untrustworthy§ʌnˈtrʌstwɜːði§adj. 不值得信任的，靠不住的§Allen should have known better than to lend such a large sum of money to that untrustworthy cousin of his.§艾伦应该知道把这么一大笔钱借给他那不可靠的堂兄是不明智的。
21016§prospective§prəˈspektɪv§adj. 预期的；未来的；可能的§Department heads composed prospective teams using a combination of people from all three categories.§部门领导从现有所有三组人中选出一些人组成未来的团队。
21017§percentage§pəˈsentɪdʒ§n. 百分比，百分率§What percentage of the workforce was employed in agriculture in this country in the mid 1900s?§在20世纪中期，这个国家从事农业的劳动力在总劳动力中占多大比例？
21018§clue§kluː§n. 线索；提示§If you do not know a word, you can look to the picture in this book for a clue to its meaning.§如果你碰到不认识的单词，可以通过书中的插图来推测它的意思。
21019§stammer§ˈstæmə(r)§n. 结巴，口吃 v. 口吃§Left-handed children, forced to use their right hand, often develop a stammer.§本来惯用左手的小孩在被迫改用右手后，通常会患口吃。
21020§swamp§swɒmp§vt. 淹没；使应接不暇 n. 沼泽§The tsunami swamped the port city.§海啸吞没了这座港口城市。
21021§jealous§ˈdʒeləs§adj. 嫉妒的；猜疑的§Tom is jealous of anyone who talks to his girlfriend.§汤姆对每个和她女友说话的人都心存猜疑。
21022§favour§ˈfeɪvə(r)§n. 帮忙；偏爱；赞同；恩惠 vt. 赞同；较喜欢，偏袒；有利于§Darkness favoured their escape.§黑暗有利于他们逃跑。
21023§fickle§ˈfɪkl§adj. 易变的，无常的§I knew that he was a fickle man, and one you could never rely on.§我知道他是个反复无常的人，你绝不能依赖他。
21024§uphill§ˌʌpˈhɪl§adv. 向上，往上；上坡；艰难地§We cycled uphill for over an hour.§我们骑自行车爬了一个多小时的山坡。
21025§defence§dɪˈfens§n. 防御，保护；辩护；答辩；[pl.] 防御力量§The defences of the country must be reinforced.§该国的防御力量必须加强。
21026§succeed§səkˈsiːd§v. 成功；接着发生§One Winter Olympics has succeeded another every four years since 1924, with a break only for the Second World War.§从1924年开始冬奥会每四年举办一次，只在二战期间中断过一次。
21027§gender§ˈdʒendə(r)§n. 性别；（语法中的）性§The gender gap is being attenuated in modern society.§在现代社会里，性别差距正在弱化。
21028§consecutive§kənˈsekjətɪv§adj. 连续不断的，连贯的§You should give a clear and consecutive narrative for your report.§你应该就你的报告给出一个清晰、连贯的陈述。
21029§diversion§daɪˈvɜːʃn§n. 转向，转移，转换；转移视线的事物；娱乐，消遣§Most water diversion projects are harmful to the fish population.§大多数的水系改道工程都会危及鱼群。
21030§donate§dəʊˈneɪt§vt. 捐赠，赠送§I should also like to say if you do have a bike to donate, it doesn't matter what con- dition it is in.§我还想说如果你有自行车可以捐赠，不管它是什么状况都没关系。
21031§volume§ˈvɒljuːm§n. 卷，册；体积；音量§This liquid was 10 litres in volume.§这一液体的体积为十升。
21032§refund§ˈriːfʌnd§n. 退款[rɪˈfʌnd] vt. 退还（钱款），偿付§You can't get a refund if you don't have any invoices.§如果你没有发票就不能获得退款。

21033§regardless§rɪˈɡɑːdləs§adv. 不顾后果地；无论如何§Regardless of the theory or model that we choose, a reduction in population size decreases the genetic diversity of a population.§无论我们选择何种理论或研究样本，人口减少都会降低该种群的基因多样性。
21034§emboss§ɪmˈbɒs§vt. 使…凸出；压花（纹）§The hotel's name was embossed on all the towels.§所有毛巾上都压印有旅馆的名字。
21035§internationalist§ˌɪntəˈnæʃnəlɪst§n. 国际主义者 adj. 国际主义者的§We established links and access to the internationalist organisations and their resources.§我们与国际主义者组织建立了联系，并有权使用他们的资源。
21036§scatter§ˈskætə(r)§v. （使人或动物）散开，驱散；撒；撒播§The farmer scattered the seeds on the field.§农民在地里播种。
21037§appetite§ˈæpɪtaɪt§n. 食欲，胃口；欲望§My supper by this time was cold, and my appetite was gone.§我的晚餐这时候已经凉了，我也没胃口了。
21038§prevail§prɪˈveɪl§vi. 流行，盛行；占优势，战胜§The use of horses for ploughing still prevails in this area.§在这一地区用马耕地还很普遍。
21039§glossary§ˈɡlɒsəri§n. 词汇表；术语表§You'll find the meaning of the difficult words used on this website in the glossary.§你能在词汇表中查到此网页上难词的意思。
21040§consolidation§kənˌsɒlɪˈdeɪʃn§n. 合并；巩固§The global airline industry was heading towards more consolidation.§全球航空业的合并之风日益盛行。
21041§mansion§ˈmænʃn§n. 大厦；（豪华的）宅邸§Mary and her family lived in a mansion.§玛丽一家住在一座大房子里。
21042§goodwill§ˌɡʊdˈwɪl§n. 友好，善意；信誉§The manufacturer will lose customers and goodwill if word gets around that the product is unreliable.§一旦产品不可靠的消息传了出去，生产商便会失去顾客及信誉。
21043§amass§əˈmæs§vt. 积聚§The monopoly capitalists amassed fabulous wealth during World War II.§二战期间，垄断资本家大发横财。
21044§federal§ˈfedərəl§adj. 联邦的，联盟的§I opened a current account at the Federal Bank.§我在联邦银行开了一个活期账户。
21045§consideration§kənˌsɪdəˈreɪʃn§n. 考虑；思考；体谅§After a few moments' consideration, they refused the invitation.§他们考虑片刻后，拒绝了邀请。
21046§grip§ɡrɪp§v. 握紧，抓牢；吸引住…的注意力（或想象力等） n. 紧握，抓牢；掌握，控制§She gripped on to the railing with both hands.§她双手紧紧抓住栏杆。
21047§galaxy§ˈgæləksi§n. [the G-] 银河；星系；群英§Scientists intend to discover a sun-like fixed star in remote galaxies.§科学家们试图在遥远的星系中找到一颗类似太阳的恒星。
21048§route§ruːt§n. 路线；路程§This map shows the route across the mountains.§这张地图上有穿越群山的路线。
21049§deficiency§dɪˈfɪʃnsi§n. 缺乏，不足§The short child of tall parents very likely had a hormone deficiency early in life.§父母个子高而孩子个子矮，极可能是孩子幼年时分泌的荷尔蒙不足造成的。
21050§opposite§ˈɒpəzɪt§prep. 在…对面 adj. 对面的，对立的；相反的，相对的 n. 对立面，对立物§The classroom is near the main entrance, just opposite the reception desk.§教室位于主入口附近，正对着接待处。
21051§sensational§senˈseɪʃənl§adj. 轰动性的，引起哗然的；耸人听闻的；极好的；绝妙的§The performance given by the newcomers is a sensational success.§新来者的表演相当成功。
21052§participation§pɑːˌtɪsɪˈpeɪʃn§n. 分享；参与§The students below 20 years old are not given the participation in the ball.§20岁以下的学生不允许参加舞会。
21053§relief§rɪˈliːf§n. （痛苦等）减轻，解除；援救，救济；宽慰；缓合剂§The relief material was flown to the flood-hit districts.§救灾物资被空运至洪灾区。
21054§cultivation§ˌkʌltɪˈveɪʃn§n. 耕种，耕作；培养，教育§Now, the cultivation of crops and the husbandry of livestock can bring great profit.§如今，种植农作物和饲养牲畜能获得丰厚的利润。
21055§pretension§prɪˈtenʃn§n. 声称，自命；自负，自命不凡§The woman, having fewer pretensions, is far more willing to learn.§这个女人并没有自命不凡，而是非常愿意学习。

21056§harness§ˈhɑːnɪs§vt. 控制，利用；上马具 n. 马具§The dam stores water for such functions as the irrigation of crops and the harnessing of the force of gravity for the generation of electricity.§大坝的存水可以用来灌溉农作物或利用重力来发电等。
21057§bent§bent§adj. 被弄弯的，弯曲的 n. 爱好，天赋§If you are buying a cot, do make sure that any metal present is not rusted or bent in any way.§购买婴儿床的时候，一定要确保床的金属不能生锈或怎么都不会被弄弯。
21058§stitch§stɪtʃ§vt. 缝，缝合 n. 一针，针脚§Susan is stitching her old clothes.§苏珊正在缝她的旧衣服。
21059§manual§ˈmænjuəl§n. 手册，指南 adj. 手的，手工的，体力的；手动的§You should read the manual instruction carefully before fixing the air-conditioner.§安装空调前你应该仔细阅读指导手册。
21060§mite§maɪt§n. 极小量；小虫，螨虫§The hives will be replaced because of mites or an ageing or dead queen.§蜂箱会因为螨虫或者蜂后的衰老或死亡等情况而被更换。
21061§burglar§ˈbɜːglə(r)§n. 窃贼§When you leave the house, make sure the windows and doors are shut, and set the burglar alarm.§当你离开房子时，务必关好门窗，并打开防盗报警器。
21062§scheme§skiːm§n. 计划，方案；体系，体制；阴谋 v. 计划，策划；密谋§The government has been funding a loans scheme for students in higher education since September 1990.§自1990年9月起，政府就开始为大学生贷款计划提供资金。
21063§addition§əˈdɪʃn§n. 加，增加（物）§This fruit is a welcome addition to the English diet.§这种添加在英式饮食中的水果很受欢迎。
21064§sensory§ˈsensəri§adj. 感觉的，感官的§Mr. Roger is a scientist working in the field of sensory perception.§罗杰先生是感官知觉领域的一名科学家。
21065§materialistic§məˌtɪəriəˈlɪstɪk§adj. 唯物主义的；物质享乐主义的，贪图享乐的§Modern society is often called materialistic.§现代社会通常被称为是物质享乐主义的。
21066§detach§dɪˈtætʃ§v. 拆卸；分开，分离；分遣§The mechanic detached the oil filter.§机修工拆下了滤油器。
21067§torrent§ˈtɒrənt§n. 洪流；爆发；（话语等的）连发§As ice and snow melted, they touched off devastating torrents of mud and debris.§冰雪融化引发了破坏力极大的泥石流。
21068§thirsty§ˈθɜːsti§adj. 口渴的；饥渴的§The moisture is absorbed by thirsty plants.§饥渴的植物吸收了水分。
21069§clarify§ˈklærəfaɪ§vt. 澄清；阐明§Talking to students about the requirements of a course helps to clarify what needs to be done.§告诉学生课程要求有助于他们了解自己所需要完成的工作。
21070§inspect§ɪnˈspekt§vt. 检查，检阅§The general inspected the troops.§将军检阅了军队。
21071§seam§siːm§n. 缝，接缝；煤层§The sailors couldn't find anything to caulk the seams in the boat.§水手们找不到任何东西来填塞船上的裂缝。
21072§agriculture§ˈægrɪkʌltʃə(r)§n. 农业；农学§§
21073§microcosm§ˈmaɪkrəʊkɒzəm§n. 微观世界；缩影§Malaysia's universities have always been a microcosm of Malaysian society.§马来西亚的大学往往是整个马来西亚社会的缩影。
